filter_instruction: Wake the evaluator only when the new activity could change the investment case. That means: a company metric or traction number (ARR, growth, customers, retention, unit economics), a change to the raise (round size, valuation, terms, a new lead investor), a change to the team (a founder joins or leaves), a new deck or data-room document, or a genuine shift in the market for the company. Do not wake it for a thank-you, a scheduling exchange, a calendar acceptance, an acknowledgement, a forwarded link with no new information, or a re-send of something already on the deal. When in doubt, do not wake it.
name: rescore-on-activity
